files.README.md:
# Portfolio

A single-page portfolio built with React 18, TypeScript and Vite.

## Direction

Calm editorial: warm paper background, ink text, one amber accent, a serif display
face against a system sans for UI. Tokens are declared on `:root` in
`src/index.css` and used everywhere — no hard-coded values in component files.

## Structure

- `index.html` — declares `<div id="root">` and loads `/src/main.tsx`.
- `src/main.tsx` — mounts `<App />` into `#root`, imports `src/index.css`.
- `src/App.tsx` — page shell: header, main, footer.
- `src/components/Hero.tsx` — display headline, lede, actions, stats.
- `src/components/About.tsx` — prose and skill tags.
- `src/components/Projects.tsx` — the portfolio section: three case-study cards.
- `src/components/Contact.tsx` — contact copy and a labelled form.

## Commands

npm install
npm run dev      # local dev server
npm run build    # production bundle
npm run preview  # serve the built bundle

## Contracts

- `src/App.tsx` default-exports the root component; `src/main.tsx` imports it as
  `import App from "./App"`.
- Every component in `src/components/` default-exports a zero-prop component.
- `#root` must exist in `index.html`; `src/main.tsx` throws a named error if it does not.
